description: Invented task-routing examples. Model names, limits, and outcomes are illustrative; none is a benchmark result.

synthetic-model-alpha.notes: A retrieval pass alone must not promote any generation task.

synthetic-model-beta.notes: Schema acceptance alone must not promote a task that fails semantics.

limitations: All values were authored for documentation and tests, not observed from an endpoint.
These examples do not establish compatibility, quality, speed, or capacity of any real model.
Actual task authorization requires separately saved validated probe artifacts.
